purpose: Source-authored predicate contract for custom Necropolis law profiles that require corpse or casualty context. This records Necropolis undead/casualty semantics only; it does not prove corpse availability, casualty accounting, battle result ordering, corpse consumption, raise consumption, or authorize gameplay mutation.

requiredStaticEvidence.corpseProducingFactPolicy: must remain runtime-unproven unless exact corpse production evidence is added

requiredRuntimeProof: corpse availability or corpse site proof
friendly versus enemy casualty ownership proof
permanent casualty versus temporary summon loss proof
corpse or casualty consumption ordering proof
law owner to battle or reward context correlation proof

forbiddenSubstitutes: undead unit identity counted as corpse availability
generic death event counted as corpse context
temporary summoned loss counted as permanent casualty
battle result loser row counted without casualty ownership proof
necropolis.casualty-corpse-accounting.notes: Necropolis casualty corpse accounting requires runtime casualty and corpse context proof; authored undead identity is static evidence only and is not corpse availability.

temporary summoned loss counted as permanent casualty
necropolis.corpse-raise-death-moon.notes: Necropolis corpse raise death moon behavior requires runtime corpse availability and raise/casualty context proof; spell text or undead identity is not enough.

necropolis.night-corpse-rite.notes: Necropolis night corpse rite requires separate spell-cast proof plus runtime corpse or casualty context proof; night spell execution alone is not corpse context.
